## Invitations

The outreach activity invited 6748 people to attend. A total of 4751 people attended, giving an attendance rate of 70.4 per cent. This indicates that most of those invited took part in the activity. The invitation arrangements were maintained across the area, with van days continuing where roads allowed. This helped preserve access for residents despite local travel conditions. The attendance figures provide a clear summary of participation during the reporting period and support the continued use of direct outreach arrangements.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS: the recorded SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded reminder total was 0. Contact therefore relied on the arrangements made through the outreach activity rather than text messaging or follow-up reminders. The available figures should be read alongside the attendance result, which records participation from those invited. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
